capabilities: Import Feishu or Lark documents from a pasted URL as Markdown
Incrementally sync tracked documents by revision ID
Download images and attachments into vault asset folders
Write frontmatter with source URL, document token, and revision
Manage Feishu OAuth login via browser-based connect, refresh, and disconnect
extras: Import is not manual; OAuth only works on desktop; asset download depends on tenant permissions; complex tables and some block types are simplified; roadmap includes bidirectional sync and conflict handling.
problem: Feishu and Lark cloud documents live outside Obsidian and have no built-in path to become editable local Markdown notes that stay up to date.

relations.evidence: Import Feishu or Lark cloud documents into your Obsidian vault as local Markdown

requires.name: Feishu app App ID and App Secret

summary: Feishu/Lark document importer that converts cloud docs into local Markdown notes with OAuth login, incremental sync, and optional asset downloads.
